content:
It's time to take a look at the latest iPhone 18 Pro cases. Pre-orders for Apple's newest products officially started this morning, and many well-known brands are ready. Apple has launched a series of color-matched silicone and TechWoven case new styles, along with the many third-party options we've loved for years. From a new burgundy color with built-in stand model, extremely grippy customizable models, to the industry's top leather cases from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods, there's something for everyone. We also have models from affordable brands like Spigen, starting at just $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Featured Pick: ESR

ESR's brand new iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories lineup is officially here, featuring premium color designs, patented technology, and more highlights. The star of the show this time is the new Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe case, with a built-in zinc alloy Flex stand integrated into the camera bump protection design, offering 3x military-grade protection, and providing a "soft elastic touch, comfortable grip." The new Atelier series, like other accessories, comes in four color options, perfectly matching the new Burgundy, Glacial, Black, and Silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case with Flex Stand $42 (was $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock MagSafe Case $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo MagSafe Wallet Stand (with Grip) $46 (was $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

Nomad is one of the top brands in leather cases, and its full lineup of best models is now ready for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. This year, the brand is also launching the all-new Rugged Case series, with each color featuring terrain patterns from Baja California:

  • Rugged Case $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Grey
  • Modern Leather Case $69 to $89
  • Traditional Leather Case $79 to $99
  • Rugged Leather Case $79
  • Colors: Rustic Brown

Featured Pick: Dbrand

Dbrand is ready, launching the proven Grip case for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. In addition to having one of the cleanest designs on the market and an extremely grippy texture, it's once again compatible with a large selection of customizable skins, letting you create your personal style; add a compatible Prism screen protector for a discount.

  • Dbrand Grip Case for iPhone 18 Pro/Max $55 Customizable, drop protection, ultra-grippy, excellent button feel
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 for iPhone 18 Pro/Max 2-pack $35 (save $5 when purchased with a case) Easy installation, auto-alignment, zero dust

This year, Dbrand is also simultaneously launching the new MNML brand cases, starting at $39, featuring minimalist and stylish designs at affordable prices, supporting MagSafe, and continuing the brand's beloved crisp button design.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $39 Black, Navy, Tan, Burgundy

The 2026 Arc Pulse aerospace-grade metal bumper case is officially here, with multiple new color options this year to match Apple's Glacial and Burgundy bodies:

  • Matte Black — $69.99

MUJJO Troubadour

  • All-Leather Case for iPhone 18 Series $59

Burton Goods

***Note: Use our exclusive discount code 9TO520 on the following cases for an additional 20% off the already discounted launch price. If the code doesn't work, try DUO10 at checkout.

  • Luxury Pocket Book Wallet Case for iPhone 18 Pro/Max $89 (was $119)
  • Heritage Leather Case for iPhone 18 Duo $60 (was $80)

UAG

UAG is also launching multiple cases for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, including the usual rugged and durable models, featuring solid corner protection, non-slip bumpers, and many models designed for drop protection. If you're looking for cases specifically designed for harsh environments and everyday protection, UAG's product lineup is definitely worth a look.

  • UAG Mouve $65 for iPhone Duo
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case $80 for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max
  • UAG Civilian Non-Slip Case from $60
  • More…

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Cases

If you want a rugged and durable case for your new iPhone but don't want to go with common brands like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut series is worth a look. These cases pass MIL-STD-810H drop testing, provide reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotating stand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're looking for a more premium case for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max that isn't too bulky, don't miss Mous. Now offering ultra-thin Aramid Fibre cases specifically designed for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, along with the other models featured below.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case $75
  • Mous Clear Case $70
  • Mouse Limitless Aramid Fibre Case $85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case $55
  • Mouse Thin Aramid Fibre Case $70
  • More…

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases feature avant-garde designs, futuristic styling, slim profiles, and stand out with textured finishes, offering a unique option among the usual case selections.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Case $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case $60 for iPhone 18 Pro
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are ideal for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max users seeking the ultimate in slim design. Their products are typically made from lightweight Aramid fiber, with minimalist and understated looks, while maintaining MagSafe compatibility and providing extra protection for the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fibre Woven Case $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop Protection Aramid Case $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protection Case $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also has a rich selection of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases, covering everything from slim everyday models to rugged and durable designs, providing reliable protection. Many new models support MagSafe, and some models even feature additional functions like more non-slip sides, accessory storage slots, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, allowing you to choose flexibly based on your desired thickness and level of protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series $60
  • More…

Belkin

Belkin is also another reliable option for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, especially suitable for users seeking minimalist designs and avoiding bulky phones, without needing to go with full-featured rugged cases. Their product lineup generally covers MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases, featuring raised edges around the display and camera, and some models like Protect+ even feature reinforced corner designs, striking a good balance between everyday protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case $30
  • Belkin Qi2-Compatible MagSafe Case with Grip $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Airbag Corners $60
